candidate._doc: Pre-filter applied while collecting, BEFORE any verification. Tier is chosen by the live (discounted) price. A deal must clear both the money floor and the claimed-% floor of its tier. Cheap items need a big %, expensive items need real money.

verdict._doc: Applied after verification against KanBkam history or a same-model market price. A deal is ok when the REAL discount clears okMin, OR when it clears warnMin and the real money saved clears its price-band floor.
verdict._ownHistory: Rows with no KanBkam record (fashion, beauty, baby, furniture) are re-judged against data/history.json — prices this pipeline observed itself — once we have at least ownHistoryMinDays distinct earlier days.

page._maxNewPerRun: Hard cap on rows added in a single run. Raised 60 -> 150 on 22 Sep (with maxRows 420 -> 900) when the rendered collectors opened Almanea's and Blackbox's full National Day catalogues. Highest verified saving wins; the rest are picked up by the next run.
